notes: This paper (BACON - Boulder Atomic Clock Optical Network) reports precision frequency ratio measurements of optical atomic clocks (27Al+, 171Yb, 87Sr) with 18-digit accuracy (6-8 × 10^-18 fractional uncertainty). It is a metrology/fundamental physics paper focused on atomic clock comparisons and SI second redefinition, NOT a dark matter or ultralight particle search. The paper mentions future applications including 'searching for undiscovered particles that have been proposed to solve problems with the Standard Model such as the nature of dark matter' but does NOT present any actual exclusion limits, sensitivity projections, or coupling constraints on axions, dark photons, or other ultralight dark matter candidates. No coupling type, mass-coupling data points, or DM density assumptions are present. This is purely an atomic clock precision measurement paper with no extractable dark matter search results.
